name: bandit.phase4_structural_signal_matrix_live_mcw
description: Phase-4 live sound-positive proof on one production-owned schema-10 structural sortie. The derived handoff fixture preserves the signal footing, adds only DEBUG_NOTEMP and DEBUG_LS for irrelevant condition control, and keeps DEBUG_CLAIRVOYANCE absent. Every long wait begins on existing non-field/non-forest terrain: road at (137,48,0) through sound observation, then the existing bandit-camp terrain at (140,51,0) for physical return. The road keeps target loaded while approach/watch/camp remain abstract; the camp footing is introduced only after the sound audit to load the return without standing on the target. An idle five-member camp autonomously dispatches its exact pair toward source-proved terrain-opportunity road target (137,49,0), approaches through (139,51,0), and watches from (138,52,0). The pair first reaches the selected watch at minute 10080 without an observation; only then does scenario setup place one real SPAWN_ACTIVE explosive on the unchanged target, and the next ordinary cadence proves one target-to-watch sound fact. Production must retain the sound fact and create exactly one returned_report sound lead only after physical return.
artifact_patterns: structural outing reached selected watch without resolving remote lead=overmap_special:bandit_camp@140,51,0:terrain_opportunity:137,49,0:road

evidence_contract.claim: one autonomous schema-10 abstract scout pair reaches its selected watch without an observation, then reads one credible post-arrival semantic explosion from the committed target footprint, retains that typed sound fact without creating camp knowledge early, and creates exactly one bounded returned_report sound lead only after physical return
evidence_contract.setup_boundary: passive debug-cloaked player road footing at (137,48,0), ordinary fitted outdoor clothing and healthy starting condition, the source-proved road lead, existing non-field bandit-camp footing at (140,51,0) only after sound observation, and one real SPAWN_ACTIVE explosive staged only after watch arrival are fixture/scenario footing; a read-only terrain/outside preflight proves each wait terrain makes EOC_LIEUTENANT_SHADOW_WARN's field/forest location conjunct false, rejects target footing, and verifies the declared loaded/abstract geometry without changing time, scheduler, ecology, sight, sound, route, or report state; the derived observer child retains only DEBUG_NOTEMP and DEBUG_LS, and the read-only condition preflight rejects DEBUG_CLAIRVOYANCE while reporting every clothing/condition transform; each wait refuses prompt acknowledgement except the owner-authorized approach-step structured EOC Enter then I recovery, so cold, hot, injury, unknown, decision, debug, and gameplay prompts terminate rather than hide a feature failure; no typed observation, signal lead, target footprint, watch selection, route position, camp report, or return is injected
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: load/setup proof only / inconclusive for the structural signal matrix
evidence_contract.observer_artifact_requirement: The same harness run must contain the exact minute-10080 abstract watch arrival with no observation, a post-arrival source-OMT-to-watch sound observation, an explicit pre-return absence of returned_report, ordered loaded-local receipts for the complete physical pair, then the production-authorized abstract handoff and one bounded returned-lead audit for the source-owned sound report. The artifact rows are authoritative for this causal proof.
evidence_contract.failure_rule: No Phase-4 sound-positive credit unless exact dispatch and approach clocks, target-loaded/watch-abstract geometry, the no-observation minute-10080 arrival, the post-arrival sound observation, pre-return no-lead state, ordered local physical receipts, and one exact same-run post-handoff returned_report sound lead are separately green.
